Name: Beautiful Vista Farm Map by glymr
Author: glymr
Description:
[size=4]A modest, yet flexible farm map with a lovely view...and a few surprises.[/size]

Retreat to a farm that mixes the beautiful with the practical!

[list]
[*]Beautiful panorama background that changes with time of day, weather, and in winter.
[*]Mini-quest chain meant for early-game play that unlocks a Secret passage [spoiler]and allows for early access to the Secret Woods with a copper axe[/spoiler]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded compatible (look for the extra mini-quest on the Grandpa's shed map to create a shortcut there. Note that SVE is NOT required, but this map is compatible with it if you have it installed)
[*]Compatible with Earthy recolor and other popular recolors
[*]Hidden guides to help with sprinkler, scarecrow, barn, coop, and silo placement if desired.
[*]Unique farmhouse
[*]The pond is deep enough for maximum casting, and you can sometimes catch mountain fish
[*]Smaller than most vanilla maps, but with plenty of space for fields and buildings
[*]A big pond for all your duck raising dreams!
[/list]
Important note for Stardew Valley Expanded players: SVE now has the ability in its Config to change the coordinates of the warp point for any custom farm map. To do so, open the Stardew Valley config (either in the Generic Mod Config Menu GMCM or the actual config.json file). Change the first option, the "Warp Location" to "Custom", the second option: Enchanted Grove X coordinate to 72, and the third option: Enchanted Grove Y coordinate to 14, and Save the changes. Let me know if you have any problems!

Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/swyrl/mods?gameId=1303]swyrl[/url], who created [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5431]Wren's Expanded Greenhouse[/url] mod. It remains my favorite greenhouse mod to this day, and I have placed a small tribute to it in this map. The area behind the greenhouse is designed to look like the default window background in Wren's Expanded Greenhouse.

Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/hisameartwork/mods?gameId=1303]hisame[/url], who I commissioned to make the world map. If you need pixel art done, I highly recommend her! She is a joy to work with and does a wonderful job. You can find her Ko-Fi here: [url=https://ko-fi.com/hisameartwork]https://ko-fi.com/hisameartwork[/url]
